predictions.prediction_text: Military action against Iran in March would massively drive up oil prices above the $90s.
predictions.condition: military action against Iran in March
predictions.expected_result: Brent front-month price rises above $90 per barrel within one week of the action

predictions.prediction_text: Damage to Arab oil refineries and shadow fleets would especially drive up distillate/gasoil prices and maintain a distillate premium (crack spread bid) in March and May.
predictions.condition: damage to Arab oil refineries and shadow fleets following military action
predictions.expected_result: Gasoil March and May contract prices increase and the gasoil–Brent crack spread widens beyond its current levels within two weeks

predictions.prediction_text: The ongoing decline in the Brent front-month versus 6-month spread indicates adaptation and suggests the front-month may not move as strongly as near-term physical signals would imply.
predictions.expected_result: The Brent front-month minus 6-month calendar spread continues to narrow over the next month

predictions.prediction_text: Massive call demand for May 26 expiry implies the market is pricing in higher May Brent prices consistent with military action expectations.
predictions.condition: market pricing of May 26 options (massive call demand)
predictions.expected_result: Implied volatility and call open interest for May 26 Brent options increase and market-implied probability of Brent > strike rises for strikes near current levels within weeks

predictions.prediction_text: Massive call demand for May expiry in gasoil implies the market is pricing a higher gasoil price by May.
predictions.condition: massive call demand for May gasoil options
predictions.expected_result: Gasoil May option implied volatility and call open interest increase and implied probability of higher May gasoil settlement rises within weeks

predictions.prediction_text: The market is strongly complacent about long-term risks despite short-term pricing of military action.
predictions.expected_result: Long-dated oil implied volatilities remain lower than short-dated vols, preserving a term-structure complacency over the next month
